recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. If reconciling the Extension Pack, make the final questionnaire-choiceOrientation source follow FHIR-56057 by removing the contextInvariant while retaining the constrained-list explanatory note; that state also satisfies FHIR-52745's goal of allowing all choice answer types.
issue_request: FHIR-52745 is an Applied FHIR-core / FHIR-I issue, resolved Persuasive with Modification, requesting that questionnaire-choiceOrientation apply to R5-and-later choice questions using all allowed Questionnaire.item.answerOption data types rather than only Coding, with a note limiting meaningful use to constrained answer lists.
initial_application: Core has no active StructureDefinition source for questionnaire-choiceOrientation; searches found only OID metadata and historical release bundles. The FHIR Extension Pack applied the seed in commit 424aae2 by adding a broader contextInvariant, then adjusted that FHIRPath in a7598a2.
additional_context: FHIR-51643 led to the reconsideration of the old version-specific contextInvariant. A linked Zulip post asked whether the invariant should be removed entirely. FHIR-56057 is a later Published FHIR-extensions decision for the same StructureDefinition that says to remove the context expression and keep the constrained-list note; current Extension Pack master has the note but also retains a contextInvariant after the FHIR-52745 application.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the core combined branch. No core files were changed because the authoritative extension definition and any remaining semantic correction belong in HL7/fhir-extensions.

related_jiras.note: Earlier issue identifying that the old contextInvariant was version-specific and inappropriate for R5, leading to the FHIR-52745 request.
Later Published decision for the same extension removes the context expression entirely while keeping the constrained-list guidance.
